limits: These are independent synthetic helper and Go-build probes, not a full runner or production-package validation. Root owns final runner validation.
External local replacement modules remain mutable and are explicitly listed by the runner; this review verified the copied server-to-connect sibling path.
Local temporary directory names and machine-specific absolute paths are removed from this handoff.
redaction: Tool output, raw commands, local temporary paths, source contents, and binaries are excluded.
scope: Read-only peer review of the throughput runner source-inspection snapshot boundary.

test_review.cwd_and_runtime_caller: The runner compiles inside the snapshot and runs from the copied package directory, covering both source-inspection forms.
test_review.file_symlink_fixtures: Readable file symlinks are copied as independent bytes; later target edits do not leak into the snapshot.
test_review.replacement_path_expectation: Use str(dep.resolve()) because the helper intentionally canonicalizes external paths and macOS tempfile paths can have a /var versus /private/var alias.
